pool_models.note: models chose which pairs were shown (TREC-style pooling), never the grades; see data/benchmark/labelling_pool.manifest.json

b1_keyword.method: Student skills: the Profile Agent's stored-record path (record_skills_text -> extract_skills -> normalize_skills). Job skills: the Job Agent's phrase splitter (split_skill_phrases) -> normalize_skills. A job skill is matched when its normalised name equals a student skill's, or one contains the other as whole words. Score = matched job skills / job skills. No embeddings, no structured features.

b2_tfidf.method: Phase 6 floor, src/embeddings/tfidf_baseline.py via the Phase 6 scorer (score_matrix, full_text protocol).

b3_structured.method: Phase 7's weighted_baseline_v1 (config/matching_baseline_v1.yaml) on the features-v2 E5 feature matrix, as the Phase 8 engine scores it. NOTE: its 20 features include 6 calibrated E5 similarity percentiles (weight 0.37 of 1.00), so it is not free of semantic signal.

b4_semantic.method: Phase 6's selected model (E5 e5-base-v2) alone, via the Phase 6 scorer (score_matrix, full_text protocol).

b5_hybrid.method: The production Stage 4 model named by config/matching_model.yaml (the trained Phase 8 model, hash-checked) on the same features-v2 E5 feature matrix: E5 similarity features + structured features + the trained model.

test.line: evaluation validity: OK — human labels, independent of the evaluated models
